name: count-up
title: Count Up
description: A number that counts to its value the first time it scrolls into view: "120 sources", "4.8k readers", "98%". The figure is the content, so the component is built around reading it, not around the motion.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/count-up

Installed to `components/ui/effects/count-up.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/count-up';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/count-up

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
